topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and the intended learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic drivers in early tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages and drive clonal evolution in pre-malignant tissues.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue stemness hierarchies and the cell of origin determine malignant transformation in leukemia and intestinal epithelia.

topics.label: Microenvironmental signals and inflammatory promotion in cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inflammatory stimuli, environmental promoters, and stromal dependencies drive tumor outgrowth and support established malignancies.

topics.label: Methodologies for profiling tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial profiling technologies used to map cancer cell evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides a comprehensive synthesis integrating genetic, epigenetic, cellular hierarchy, and microenvironmental dynamics in cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapeutics.
